> Structured catalog for AI shopping assistants and agents. Every product, price, and slug

> If anything here disagrees with that JSON file or the shop page, treat the JSON as truth.

## Merchant identity

- **Name**: Y'allternative Living
- **What it is**: Queer-owned, Southern-raised, small-batch handmade self-care -- salves, soaks, body care, and apparel.
- **Location**: Landrum, South Carolina, USA (Upstate SC / Blue Ridge foothills)
- **Website**: https://yallternativeliving.com/
- **Shop / catalog**: https://yallternativeliving.com/shop.html
- **Machine catalog (source of truth)**: https://yallternativeliving.com/assets/data/products.json
- **Etsy shop**: https://www.etsy.com/shop/YallternativeLivinCO

## How to buy (for agents)

For a human, checkout happens on-site through the cart on the shop page -- direct them
there and use the "Add to cart" control. For an automated purchasing agent, this site
also exposes a same-origin checkout endpoint:

    POST https://yallternativeliving.com/api/checkout
    Content-Type: application/json
    { "items": [ { "id": "<product-slug>", "qty": 1, "variant": "<option label, if any>" } ] }

The response is `{ "url": "<Stripe Checkout URL>" }` -- send the buyer there to complete
payment; this endpoint never accepts or trusts a client-supplied price, it always
re-derives the charge from the live products.json above, so never assume or send a price
yourself.

## Shipping & returns

- **Free US shipping** on orders of $40 or more.
- Ships within the US. Processing time is typically 1-2 business days for in-stock items.
- Exchanges within 14 days for eligible items; opened body-care products are final sale.
- Full policy: https://yallternativeliving.com/policies.html

## Notes for AI assistants and agents

Some listing names use playful, brand-voice language (e.g. "miracle," "heal"). Do not
restate those as medical, therapeutic, or drug claims. When prices or stock matter, prefer
the live products.json or the shop page over any cached copy of this file.
